items.exampleEn: He did his duty and told the judge the truth.
items.exampleZh: 他盡了自己的責任，向法官說出真相。

items.exampleEn: Politicians often give speeches on TV.
items.exampleZh: 政治人物常常在電視上演講。

items.exampleEn: She hopes to become governor one day.
items.exampleZh: 她希望有一天能當上州長。

items.exampleEn: The grant paid for my new computer.
items.exampleZh: 這筆補助金支付了我的新電腦。

items.exampleEn: The film is about a clever criminal.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影講的是一個聰明的罪犯。

items.exampleEn: Nobody witnessed the moment the vase fell.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人目擊花瓶掉下來的那一刻。

items.exampleEn: A sales representative visited our office.
items.exampleZh: 一位業務代表來拜訪我們的辦公室。

items.exampleEn: A bomb is a very dangerous weapon.
items.exampleZh: 炸彈是非常危險的武器。

items.sentenceEn: My father sees it as his duty to help others.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸爸認為幫助別人是他的責任。

items.audioEn: If you witnessed what happened on the playground this morning, please talk to your teacher.
items.audioZh: 如果你目擊了今天早上操場上發生的事，請跟你的老師說。
items.questionZh: 說話者請目擊者做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The company sent a representative to the event.
items.sentenceZh: 公司派了一位代表參加這場活動。

items.sentenceEn: The city got a grant to clean the river.
items.sentenceZh: 市政府拿到一筆補助金來清理河川。

items.stemEn: The police showed a photo of the ____ on the news.
items.stemZh: 警方在新聞上公布了罪犯的照片。

items.stemEn: Each class chooses a ____ to speak at student meetings.
items.stemZh: 每班選一位代表在學生會議上發言。

items.passageEn: Here is the news from our town paper this week. First, workers found an old bomb from a war long ago at a building site. The police closed the street, and experts made it safe. Second, a woman who witnessed a man painting on the walls of the town hall at night helped the police catch the criminal. Third, the state governor gave our school a grant to build a new library and hire a librarian. Our class representative, Tom, thanked him in a short speech. Tom said it is every student's duty to take care of the new books. A local politician also came, but she did not speak.
items.passageZh: 以下是本週鎮上報紙的新聞。第一，工人在一處工地發現一枚很久以前戰爭留下的舊炸彈。警方封鎖了街道，專家把它處理得安全了。第二，一位女士目擊有人半夜在鎮公所的牆上塗鴉，幫警方抓到了這名罪犯。第三，州長給了我們學校一筆補助金，用來蓋新圖書館再聘請圖書館員。我們的班代 Tom 發表簡短的演說向他道謝。Tom 說愛護新書是每個學生的責任。一位地方政治人物也來了，但她沒有發言。

questions.questionZh: 那位女士幫警方做了什麼？
Tom 說每個學生的責任是什麼？

referenceEn: I once witnessed a car accident.
I witnessed a car accident once.
rubricZh: witness 表示「目擊」，例如 witness an accident 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 duty 造一個句子，說說你在家的責任。
referenceEn: It is my duty to wash the dishes after dinner.
Taking out the trash is my duty at home.
rubricZh: duty 表示「責任、職責」，例如 it is my duty to… 等說法
說的是自己的事（例如 my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
